title: Reading Critical Power Paths
summary: Trace a simplified data-center power path and its dependencies.
objectives: Interpret utility to rack power flow.

vocab.def: The organized delivery of power to different loads.
A power distribution unit that distributes power to equipment.

sections.heading: Trace the model
sections.body: A simplified path may be utility -> switchgear -> UPS -> distribution -> rack PDU -> server. Facilities differ, so this is an educational model.
